description: Enterprise techniques used by CRASHPAD, ATT&CK software S9057 (v1.0)
name: CRASHPAD (S9057)

techniques.comment: [CRASHPAD](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9057) has impersonated the `explorer.exe` user privileges to call Windows API `CryptUnprotectData`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[CRASHPAD](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9057) has extracted credentials saved within web browsers.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)

[CRASHPAD](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9057) has decrypted the config file ` C:\Program Files\VMware\VMware Tools\VMware VGAuth\config.txt ` to move the contents to a newly created file called ` C:\Program Files\VMware\VMware Tools\VMware VGAuth\crash.log `.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
[CRASHPAD](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9057) has leveraged Windows Native API, such as `CryptUnprotectData`, to decrypt functions.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Nov2025)
